The '''Kedra system''' was a part of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of [[Kedran lip-smear]].<ref name="TSSE">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Kedran lip-smear]]|system=Kedra [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Kedra [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
